phrases.known_text: If you had told me, I would have driven
phrases.target_text: Si me hubieras dicho, habría conducido
phrases.why: if-clause fronted before matrix; had-side (2nd-person hubieras) plus would-side in clause-final position

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't have driven home if it had been my choice
phrases.target_text: No habría conducido a casa si hubiera sido mi decisión
phrases.why: negated matrix gives a second would-side shape; had-side here is 3rd-person hubiera sido

phrases.known_text: I would have driven there if I had known
phrases.target_text: Habría conducido hasta allí si hubiera sabido
phrases.why: affirmative matrix-first skeleton; had-side reuses 1st-person hubiera with a different verb, sabido

phrases.known_text: If I had driven safely, I would have been happy
phrases.target_text: Si hubiera conducido de manera segura, habría estado encantado
phrases.why: if-clause fronted carries the LEGO medially; would-side matrix uses a different participle, estado encantado

phrases.known_text: I think I would have driven today if you'd told me that
phrases.target_text: Pienso que habría conducido hoy si me hubieras dicho eso
phrases.why: matrix think embeds the whole counterfactual; would-side under pienso que, had-side 2nd-person hubieras plus eso

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't have driven yesterday if you hadn't told me
phrases.target_text: No habría conducido ayer si no me hubieras dicho
phrases.why: negation on both matrix and if-clause; had-side is a negated 2nd-person hubieras shape
